expressions.cue: Duration: 1 month(s). Use the か月 counter (equivalent spellings accepted), without final 間; not the native つき series.
expressions.explanation: か月, ヶ月, 箇月, カ月, ヵ月 and ケ月 spell the same duration unit. The cue targets this unit without 間. Native 一月/ひと月 and 二月/ふた月 can also express month durations, but belong to a different requested form.
